# WitnessADR

> WitnessADR is an open-source (Apache 2.0) Python library for tamper-evident AI agent decision logging. It records each consequential agent decision as a cryptographically hash-chained, Ed25519-signed Agent Decision Record (ADR) that any third party can independently verify with only read access — no vendor trust required.

## Overview

- [README](README.md) — Project overview, quick start, architecture, comparison with Langfuse/LangSmith/Kosmoy

## Code

- [packages/core/](packages/core/) — `witnessadr-core`: canonical serialization, hashing, signing, verification, redaction
- [packages/storage_sqlite/](packages/storage_sqlite/) — `witnessadr-storage-sqlite`: SQLite store (sync + async)
- [packages/cli/](packages/cli/) — `witnessadr` CLI: init / verify / export
- [packages/adapter_langchain/](packages/adapter_langchain/) — LangChain callback handler
- [packages/adapter_openai/](packages/adapter_openai/) — OpenAI SDK wrapper
